scope: Content research for a premium India travel homepage, with Varanasi as the principal focus. Client brand and operational capabilities remain unconfirmed.
research_method: All six supplied content-reference homepages read live through Agent Reach using Jina Reader. Web browsing supplied additional source-linked verification against government tourism and district websites. No competitor prose, imagery, prices, testimonials or business claims are licensed or approved for reuse by this research.

reference_sites.name: Balaji Travels
reference_sites.access: Successfully read through Jina Reader; native web extraction was limited.
useful_patterns: Varanasi as principal destination with short stays and longer regional circuits.
Separate pilgrimage interests and linked routes connecting Prayagraj, Ayodhya, Varanasi and Bodh Gaya.
Detailed itinerary, inclusions, exclusions and practical route information.

reference_sites.name: Jatak Travels
reference_sites.access: Successfully read through Jina Reader and native web browsing.
useful_patterns: Destination depth beyond temples: ghats, music, heritage, handicrafts, cuisine and walking tours.

cautions: Homepage still contains 2018 and 2019 festival promotions; dates cannot be treated as current.
Keyword-heavy SEO copy and No. 1 claims should not be reproduced.

reference_sites.access: Successfully read through Jina Reader and native web browsing.

cautions: International emphasis is less relevant than the planning pattern.
Do not transfer deposit terms, comparative price claims or package rates.

content_direction.status: Proposed editorial direction; not an assertion of client services.
hierarchy: Lead with Varanasi and its cultural depth.
Give all eight requested destinations clear visibility and distinct identities.
Use suggested journeys to explain how destinations connect.
Invite broader India enquiries as a secondary direction.
Prioritize trip-planning clarity over a long vehicle catalogue or many repetitive package cards.
content_direction.experience_interest_note: Interests are editorial categories only. Specific arranged activities require confirmation of client capabilities and availability.

destinations.name: Varanasi
destinations.proposed_one_line: River mornings, evening aarti and old lanes that reward a slower walk.
verified_subjects: Evening Ganga Aarti at Dashashwamedh Ghat
destinations.qualification: Do not promise exact aarti times, boating availability, exclusive access or arranged performances without current operational confirmation.

destinations.name: Prayagraj
destinations.proposed_one_line: A pause at the Sangam, where the Ganga and Yamuna meet.
verified_subjects: Saraswati as part of religious tradition
destinations.qualification: Describe the Saraswati as mythical, believed or part of religious tradition, rather than a third visible river. Do not reuse stale Kumbh dates from district pages.

destinations.name: Ayodhya
destinations.proposed_one_line: Temple courtyards and evenings along the Sarayu.
destinations.qualification: Avoid exact temple dimensions, pillar counts and airport statements from these sources; conflicting or dated details were observed. Temple access remains subject to current rules.

destinations.name: Lucknow
destinations.proposed_one_line: Awadhi flavours, grand gateways and the gracious pace of the old city.
destinations.qualification: Avoid superlatives and exact construction dates from these pages. A food interest does not imply a confirmed guided food tour service.

destinations.name: Gaya
destinations.proposed_one_line: Vishnupad Temple and a city deeply connected with remembrance.
destinations.qualification: Keep ancestral rites individually requested and distinct from sightseeing. Do not imply the client arranges ritual services. Verify temple entry restrictions for each traveller.

destinations.name: Bodh Gaya
destinations.proposed_one_line: Time for stillness around the Mahabodhi Temple and Buddhist monasteries.
destinations.qualification: Use distinct naming from Gaya. Do not assert access to meditation sessions or monastery programmes without confirmation.

destinations.name: Vrindavan
destinations.proposed_one_line: Temple lanes, devotional music and the living traditions of Braj.
verified_subjects: Relationship to nearby Mathura and the Braj region
destinations.qualification: Specific darshan times, access and festival arrangements require current verification.

destinations.name: Agra
destinations.proposed_one_line: The Taj Mahal, red-sandstone ramparts and another chapter of Mughal India.
verified_subjects: Taj Mahal closed to general sightseeing on Fridays
destinations.qualification: Plan around the Taj's Friday closure and recheck ticket rules before selling an itinerary. Do not import dated airfare, train or airport claims.

proposed_homepage_faqs.question: How do I choose a route across several cities?
proposed_homepage_faqs.answer: Start with the places that matter most to you, then allow time for travel between them. Your dates, arrival city and preferred pace help turn a destination list into a practical route.
proposed_homepage_faqs.status: Original proposed editorial guidance. Makes no claim that the client provides a particular custom-planning service.

proposed_homepage_faqs.question: What should older travellers consider when planning?
proposed_homepage_faqs.answer: Temple lanes and river ghats can involve steps, uneven surfaces and walking. Note any walking limits, stair concerns and rest preferences early, and check access at each stop before confirming a route.
proposed_homepage_faqs.status: Original proposed practical guidance. Does not promise accessibility, assistance, step-free routes or a client service.

unconfirmed_client_information: Trading name, logo and brand identity
Business address, contact number, email and social accounts
Private or group trip model, vehicle ownership and guide arrangements
Custom-planning capabilities, accessibility assistance and support hours
Prices, inclusions, exclusions, availability and booking process
Verifiable credentials, customer reviews, experience years and performance claims
Rights to supplied or selected photographs
content_warnings: Never import competitor No. 1 claims, customer counts, satisfaction percentages, experience years, star ratings or testimonials.
Do not publish invented starting prices or imply that proposed route durations are verified client products.
Do not promise VIP darshan, queue bypass, guaranteed temple access, exclusive boats or special permissions without verified arrangements.
Do not conflate Gaya with Bodh Gaya.
Treat religious traditions and mythological associations as beliefs where appropriate.
Do not copy photography from reference sites without checking rights and provenance.
Avoid stale festival promotions and unverified dates.

Even official tourism pages contain contradictions and dated details. Restrained landmark-level descriptions were selected; exact timings, prices, transport details and numerical trivia need fresh operational checks.
The homepage concept should use client-approved contact details before connecting any live enquiry or reservation flow.

workspace_hygiene.note: Research was read in memory. No competitor image downloads, temporary reports or scratch files were created by this research task.
